title: Ruth and Boaz
description: Ruth gleans grain in Boaz's field. Boaz takes her as his wife as the kinsman-redeemer and raises up the name of the deceased. From them descends King David.

versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal covers Ruth 2:1–4:22, which overlaps with two existing stories: 'Ruth gleans in Boaz's field' (Ruth 2) and 'Ruth and the kinsman-redeemer at the city gate' (Ruth 4). The proposals can be merged into one cohesive story about Ruth and Boaz.; [minor] category: The category 'Judges' fits historically, as the book of Ruth takes place during the time of the judges.
